title: Azion Web Platform | Azion (home)
description:
GLOBAL SITE CHROME (all 4 site pages): dark-only theme (pure black #000 page, white text, Azion orange #F3652B accent; no light theme exists, prefers-color-scheme is ignored). Content sits in a centred ~1386px framed column whose left/right edges are 1px hairline rules with small square 'registration mark' dots at section corners; between sections there are ~190px spacer bands filled with a fine vertical-line pattern. Top nav (56px, sticky): orange italic AZION wordmark left; menu triggers 'Solutions', 'Products', 'Developer', 'Resources' (each with chevron, open mega-menus on hover/click) and a plain 'Pricing' link; right side: 'Contact' text link, 'Login' (white filled small button), 'Start for free' (orange filled small button), square search icon button. At 390px the nav collapses to hamburger + wordmark + orange 'Start for free' + search icon. Section eyebrows use a monospace uppercase label prefixed by an orange '//' (e.g. '// PRICING'). Footer: 4 link columns with muted headings — Company (About us, Our Network, Careers, Compliance, Privacy Policy, Hey AI, learn about us), Resources (Blog, Resource Hub, Learning, Marketplace, Success cases, Recognition and Awards), Getting Started (Start for free, How to start, Pricing, Contact, Professional Services, Scale-Up Program), Developer (Documentation, API, Our Community ↗, Release Notes); bottom bar: wordmark + social icons (GitHub, LinkedIn, YouTube, X, Instagram, Discord) left, green dot 'All Systems Operational' + globe 'EN' language select right. Cookie banner and HubSpot chat launcher were dismissed/removed before capture (they are third-party overlays, not part of the design). Capture note: in the 390px full-page images the sticky header re-appears once mid-page (stitching artefact of a hide-on-scroll header); treat it as a single sticky header.

PAGE (1440 full height ≈9400px): 1) HERO (full-width, ~380px tall, black with a dotted-grid band behind the lower half): centred 2-line H1 ~48px — line 1 'Invisible infrastructure' in orange, line 2 'for the speed of AI' in white; 3-line muted subtitle 'Compute, AI, data, security, and observability primitives that run autonomously and scale instantly on 100+ data centers worldwide. One platform, from idea to mission-critical.'; two buttons side by side: 'Start free' (white filled) and 'Talk to a specialist ›' (dark outline). 2) LOGO STRIP: mono uppercase caption 'PROVEN ON MISSION-CRITICAL WORKLOADS' then a horizontally auto-scrolling marquee of greyscale customer logos (NZN, Netshoes, Caixa, agibank, prime video, Madeira Madeira, GPA, Fourbank, GFG, HeroSpark…). 3) PRIMITIVES GRID: centred H2 'Serverless AI-native primitives for autonomous workloads' (2 lines, ~36px) above a bordered 4-column table-like grid (column header row with orange mono labels COMPUTE / AI / DATA / SECURITY). Each cell lists items as icon + bold title + one-line muted description: Compute = Functions, Durable Objects, Rules Engine, Load Balancer, Image Processor; AI = AI Inference, AI Gateway; Data = Object Storage, SQL Database, KV Store, Cache; Security = Web Application Firewall, API Gateway, Bot Manager, DNS. Items are links (rendered as nav 'Platform primitives'). 4) NETWORK BAND (~700px): left text — eyebrow '// REGION: EARTH.', H2 'One distributed infrastructure without the complexity of managing, securing, and scaling it', mono caption 'BUILT AROUND YOUR USERS. DISTRIBUTED AROUND YOUR DATA.', and 4 outlined orange pill stats (100+ data centers, 100+ Tbps network capacity, 30 ms median latency, 100% availability); right — dot-matrix map of the Americas with orange highlighted dots. Below it a 4-column row of customer proof cards (logo + sentence with bold metric): Dafiti '86% faster load times, with a 45% cost reduction in data transfer'; MadeiraMadeira '90% lower cloud costs and faster applications at scale'; Renner '67% saved on data transfer…'; Fourbank 'DDoS mitigated on applications and APIs…'. 5) WHY AZION: eyebrow '// WHY AZION', H2 'From commit to observability, on one platform', subtitle; then 4 equal cells each with a dark illustration (branch diagram main/stage/preview/production; key table PREVIEW/TEST/PROD with active/revoked/expired statuses; orange Azion glyph tile in a circuit; bar chart 1w–6w with orange highlight) and a caption whose first sentence is bold: 'Build at AI speed.', 'Secure by default.', 'No ops required.', 'Faster and more efficient workloads.'. 6) USE-CASE ROWS: 5 stacked 2-column rows (text left, illustration right on a dotted orange gradient): 'Modern applications' (terminal card with framework icons and AZION INIT/BUILD/DEPLOY chips), 'Optimized workloads' (browser mock with 'WWW.YOURSITE.COM SECURE' and a green '99' score ring), 'AI applications' (Azion tile connected to AI provider icons), 'Protected applications and APIs' (4 icon tiles), 'Media and streaming content' (map with icon tiles); each has H3 ~28px, 2-line description and a small outline 'Learn more ›' button. 7) RECOGNITION: eyebrow '// RECOGNITION AND AWARDS', H2 'Recognized as a market leader', then a horizontally auto-scrolling carousel of ~470px quote cards (logo G2/GigaOm/Frost & Sullivan, quote mark, quote text, orange mono source label like 'G2 WINTER 2026 REPORTS'). 8) CLIENT STORIES: mosaic grid — large photo card 'Netshoes automatically blocks more than 4 million threats in six months' + 'Learn more ›', medium photo card GPA 'Grupo Pão de Açúcar (GPA) stops a cyberattack and reduces costs by 30%', and logo tiles (Dafiti on white, agibank on black, Renner black, Fourbank orange, exame black, NZN orange). 9) CLOSING CTA: dotted orange gradient background, centred H2 'Build, secure, and scale applications everywhere.', subtitle 'Get faster launches, lower latency, and less infrastructure overhead from day one.', 'Start free' + 'Talk to a specialist ›'. 10) Footer. Mobile 390: single column; hero buttons full-width stacked; primitives grid becomes one column with each category label as a divider; map band stacks text over map; stats/cards stack.

PAGE (≈11700px): 1) HERO: eyebrow '// PRICING', centred H1 'Infrastructure without the waste', 3-line muted paragraph about paying only for what you use. 2) PLAN CARDS: centred segmented control 'Monthly' (selected, filled) / 'Annual'; below a 3-column bordered row of plan cards (the middle one has a slightly lighter surface): HOBBY — mono label, price 'Free' (~48px), section label 'All features available', checklist with small orange icons (Global infrastructure, Serverless functions, Storage and databases, Image optimization, DDoS protection & firewall), full-width dark 'Start free' button; PRO — label + orange 'Popular' badge, '$25 /mo', muted 'Billed monthly, cancel anytime', 'Scale beyond included usage' list (Additional workloads, Higher application limits, More storage capacity, Broader security coverage, Configurable spend limits), white filled 'Start with Pro'; ENTERPRISE — 'Custom', 'Tailored to your usage and payment terms', 'Choose your pricing model' list (On-demand pricing, Lower costs with commitments, Reserved Capacity available, Savings Plan available, Advanced support available), dark 'Contact us'. 3) VALUE PROPS: 3 cells with illustrations: 'No idle. No waste', 'Stay in control' (TRAFFIC/COST chart), 'White-glove when it matters' (chat+headset icons); bold lead sentence + muted continuation. 4) FEATURE COMPARISON TABLE (very long): sticky header row 'FEATURES' | Hobby + 'Start free' | Pro (orange top border, white 'Start with Pro') | Enterprise + 'Contact us'. Grouped into product sections, each opened by an orange eyebrow + H3 + subtitle: '// MANAGED INFRASTRUCTURE Azion Platform', '// BUILD Azion Applications', '// STORE Storage & Databases', '// SECURE Azion Connectors', '// SECURE Azion Firewall', '// SECURE Azion Edge DNS', '// OBSERVE Real-Time Observability', '// AZION PLATFORM Compliance', '// ENTERPRISE CONTRACTS Contract Discounts'. Inside each, sub-group header rows (e.g. Global Infrastructure, Management, Access Security, Workloads, Functions, Cache, Object Storage, Firewall, Web Application Firewall…) and feature rows: muted label in col 1, centred values in the plan columns — green check icons, '—' dashes, or text like '10 included', '1 TB / month included', 'Upon request (subject to approval)', 'Custom'. Ends with a blue 'See on-demand pricing →' link. 5) PRIMITIVES GRID (same as home, H2 'Serverless AI-Native Primitives for Autonomous Workloads'). 6) FAQ: 2-column — left H2 'Frequently Asked Questions'; right accordion of 12 collapsed rows separated by hairlines, each question text + chevron-down (e.g. 'How do I know what is included in each plan?', 'What is the difference between monthly and annual billing?', 'Can I cancel or change my plan at any time?'). 7) Closing CTA (same as home). 8) Footer. Mobile 390: plan cards stack vertically; the comparison table becomes a single plan column chosen by a sticky bottom bar with a plan select ('Pro ▾') and a 'Start with Pro' button.

title: Azion Docs — Overview (docs home)
description:
GLOBAL DOCS CHROME: light theme default (page bg #F5F5F5, white cards/code blocks, near-black text) with a full dark theme (black bg, #0a0a0a cards) that follows prefers-color-scheme or a 3-way System/Dark/Light switch at the bottom of the sidebar. Header (56px, sticky, white): orange AZION wordmark + small boxed 'DOCS' tag, top tabs 'Reference', 'Guides', 'Developer tools ▾'; right: search field ('Search' + 'CTRL K' kbd hint), square GitHub icon button, black 'Console' button. Body is a 3-column layout at 1440px: left sidebar 300px (white, its own scroll, viewport-height) with collapsible nav groups (chevron right/down, active item = grey filled pill), and at its bottom a theme segmented control (monitor/moon/sun icons) and a '«' collapse button; centre content column ~840px max (prose, 16px body, generous 48–80px gaps between H2 sections, H2s separated by 1px rules); right rail ~240px with 'ON THIS PAGE' TOC (mono uppercase label, active item has an orange left bar), 'GITHUB' links (Azion Docs, Contribute to this page), 'COMMUNITY' links (Discord, blog, X) and a promo card (orange wordmark, 'Ready to build?', copy, orange 'Start for free' + outline 'See our plans'). Article pages share a header block: breadcrumb (e.g. 'Fundamentals › Get started › First deploy'), H1 (~36px), lead paragraph (18px, medium), meta row with icons: 'Last updated Nov 11, 2026' | 'Copy as Markdown' | 'View as Markdown' | 'Agent setup'. Common components: callouts (blue-tint info box with circle-i icon; orange-tint tip with bulb icon), numbered step lists (number in a small square badge with a vertical connector), code blocks (white card, header with language label e.g. 'Shell'/'JSON'/'Text', line numbers '01 02…', syntax colouring in orange/blue, copy icon button top-right), inline code chips (grey bg, mono 11px), link-card grids (bordered grid of cells, each with outline icon, title, one-line muted description, optional blue 'Action ›' link), 'Next steps' 2-col card grid, a 'Next page ›' / '‹ Previous page' pager, then the same 4-column footer as the marketing site but light. At 390px: sidebar and right rail are hidden; header becomes hamburger + wordmark + search icon + GitHub icon + 'Console'; all grids collapse to one column.

PAGE (≈4500px, no breadcrumb/TOC — the right rail is absent and the content column spans ~1090px): sidebar shows 'Getting Started' group (Overview active, Fundamentals ›, Agent Setup ›, Use Cases ›, Support ›, Marketplace ›), 'Platform Resources' group (Workloads, Applications, Firewall, Functions, Connectors, AI Inference, Real-Time Metrics, Real-Time Events, Data Stream, Edge Pulse, Edge DNS, Object Storage, SQL Database, KV Store — each with ›) and 'Management'. 1) HERO: H1 'Welcome to Azion Docs' (~44px), lead 'We make every application fast and reliable. Deploy on a global network with enterprise-grade security and no cold starts.', buttons: orange 'Get started' + black 'Copy prompt' button carrying 4 small AI-tool logos; caption 'The prompt hands your coding agent the CLI, live docs over MCP, and this project linked.' 2) 'Start by interface' (H2 + subtitle): a dark feature banner split 70/30 — left 'Your AI agent, fluent in Azion' + description + 'Copy prompt' button; right 'Prefer the guided route?' + orange 'Agent setup', with an orange dot-pattern decoration — followed by a 3-cell card row: Console ('Access the Console ›'), CLI ('Install the CLI ›'), API ('Call the API ›'). 3) 'Start by objective': 2-col grid of 5 cells (Build your application, Accelerate your application, Secure your application, Execute AI inference, Explore use cases spanning both columns) + 'Also useful: Observe' line. 4) 'Ready-made templates': 4×2 grid of framework tiles with coloured logos (React, Next.js, Astro, Vue.js, Angular, Gatsby Blog, Hono, Hugo) + 'Also useful: First deploy, Frameworks compatibility'. 5) 'Stop attacks': 3-col grid of 7 cells (Add a firewall, Block injection attacks, Tune false positives, Deny bad bots, Network blocklists, Install TLS certificates, Stream to SIEM) + reference links line. 6) 'Assess risk and prove compliance': 3×2 grid (Shared Responsibility Model, Governance Risk and Compliance, PCI DSS compliance, SOC compliance, Activity History, Security Response Team) + 'Access governance: …' links. 7) 'Follow along': grid (Release notes, Blog 'Read the blog ↗', YouTube 'Watch on YouTube ↗', Discord 'Join the Discord ↗', Style guide). 8) Pager 'Next page › Agent setup'. 9) Footer. Cells: white bg, hairline borders shared between cells (grid without gaps), 24px padding, 20px outline icon, 14px semibold title, 12px muted description.
